verdict: Same studio as SgmuplXU2iY: white/blue palette, floating tilted app windows, typewriter captions (sheet_1 frames 150-260).
Adds blurred stock footage under the UI window to add 'human' context without hiding the product (frames 260-500).
Feature emphasis via cursor + black tooltip pill + blue circular badges, not boxes or spotlights.
Only 3 hard cuts; UI sequences use dissolves/slides, avg shot ~96 frames.
Ends with logo, pill CTA 'Try free' and URL; result beat shows outcome (greetings in several languages) rather than a UI screen.
